conn.chooseOrCreate: Choose or create a connection to get started

guide.title: Create your first connection context
guide.body: Contexts are shared with natscli. Create one to connect to your NATS server — you can test the connection before saving.

messages.subject: Subject
messages.subjectInvalid: Subject is required and must not contain spaces
messages.msgIdHint: JetStream deduplication: messages sharing a Nats-Msg-Id within the dedupe window are stored once and reported as duplicates.
messages.sizeWarn: This payload is {{size}}. Large messages slow the connection and may hit the server's max payload. Send anyway?
messages.sizeReject: Payload exceeds the 8 MiB limit ({{size}}); it was not sent.
messages.binaryPreview: Binary payload ({{bytes}} bytes), shown as hex
messages.notConnected: Connect to a server to send messages.

sessions.notConnected: Subscription sessions live only while connected — connect to a server first.
sessions.empty: No sessions yet — subscribe to a subject to start receiving messages.

trace.traceOnlyHint: The probe carries Nats-Trace-Only and never reaches the final subject. Turn this off to actually deliver the message.

backup.backupHint: Snapshot stream “{{name}}” into a directory on this machine.
backup.restoreHint: Pick a directory containing a backup.json snapshot; the stream is recreated from it.
backup.overwriteBody: The selected backup’s target stream already exists on this server; restoring with overwrite deletes and recreates it.

streams.notConnected: Streams live only while connected — connect to a server first.
streams.listEmpty: No streams match — adjust the filter or create a stream.

msgs.title: Messages
msgs.truncatedHint: Page rows carry only the first 64 KiB — the full payload is loaded for viewing and download.
msgs.deleteBody: Message #{{seq}} in stream {{stream}} will be permanently removed.

unavailable.title: JetStream data unavailable
unavailable.no_responders: JetStream answered the stream list request with “no responders” — the $JS.API subjects got no reply.
unavailable.timeout: The stream list request timed out before JetStream answered.
unavailable.server: The server reported an error while listing streams.
unavailable.checkDomain: Check the JetStream domain in Settings → Connections: a wrong domain routes $JS.API requests nowhere (domain mismatch = no responders).
unavailable.checkPrefix: Check the API prefix in Settings → Connections: it must match the server's api_prefix (usually empty).

detail.emptyBody: Pick a stream on the left to inspect its stats, rate history, mirror/sources and cluster placement.

form.name: Name
form.nameIllegal: Name must not contain spaces or other illegal characters
form.subjectsRequired: At least one subject is required unless mirroring
form.limitsInvalid: Limits must be whole numbers ≥ -1 (-1 = unlimited)
form.ageInvalid: Max age must be a whole number of seconds ≥ 0
form.seqInvalid: Start sequence must be a whole number ≥ 0
form.replicasInvalid: Replicas must be a whole number between 1 and 5

confirm.purgeBody: All messages in this stream are removed permanently. The stream itself stays.
confirm.sealBody: A sealed stream refuses new messages until it is unsealed on the server.

error.notFound: Resource not found — the view has been refreshed

consumers.notConnected: Consumer information is only available while connected — connect to a server first.
consumers.listEmpty: No consumers match — adjust the filter or create a consumer.

unavailable.title: JetStream data unavailable
unavailable.no_responders: JetStream answered the consumer list request with “no responders” — the $JS.API subjects got no reply.
unavailable.timeout: The consumer list request timed out before JetStream answered.
unavailable.server: The server reported an error while listing consumers.
unavailable.checkDomain: Check the JetStream domain in Settings → Connections: a wrong domain routes $JS.API requests nowhere (domain mismatch = no responders).
unavailable.checkPrefix: Check the API prefix in Settings → Connections: it must match the server's api_prefix (usually empty).

detail.emptyBody: Pick a consumer on the left to inspect its stats, rate history, configuration echo and pause state.

confirm.resetBody: Its delivery state is reset to sequence {{seq}}; messages are redelivered according to the deliver policy.
confirm.deleteBody: The consumer and its ack state are removed from stream {{stream}}. The messages themselves are kept.

error.notFound: Resource not found — the view has been refreshed

preview.title: Pull preview
preview.pausedHint: The consumer is paused — resume it to pull messages.
preview.batchInvalid: Batch must be a whole number between 1 and 256.

form.filterSubjectsHint: One subject per line (at most 10; empty = all)
form.backoffHint: Comma-separated, each ≥ 1 second, at most 100 steps
form.deliverSubjectRequired: Deliver subject is required for push consumers
form.filterSubjectEmpty: Filter subjects must not be empty
form.secondsInvalid: Seconds fields must be whole numbers ≥ 0
form.backoffInvalid: Backoff steps must be whole numbers ≥ 1 second
form.startSeqInvalid: Start sequence must be a whole number
form.startTimeInvalid: Start time must be a whole number of milliseconds
form.startSeqRequired: Start sequence must be ≥ 1 for start_sequence
form.startTimeRequired: A valid start time is required for start_time

connections.title: Connections
connections.empty: No contexts yet — create one to get started.
connections.name: Name
connections.deleteActive: This context is active and will be disconnected first. Continue?
connections.envWarning: CLI environment variables detected ({{vars}}). This app ignores them and uses context files only.
connections.nameInvalid: Name is required and must not contain path separators
connections.urlInvalid: Enter a valid nats:// or tls:// URL
connections.conflictBody: "{{name}}" was modified by another program while you were editing. Keep your changes, or load the stored version?
